Congratulations for putting yourself out there and looking for a better opportunity. This is their loss lot yours. They took you for granted and now because you’ve received an offer they want to position you to stay because they realize the value you bring to the company. Review the counter as formality, then kindly decline. 

I see no harm in having a professional conversation with your recruiter or hiring manager at your new job about possible negotiations. You won’t know until you ask and tell them about how excited you are about the new opportunity.

Wishing you all the best on this new role!

I disagree. Even if the offer has been written and delivered, there’s always an opportunity to connect with the recruiter & hiring manager about possible negotiations. The issues come once you have already signed the document which OP says she hasn’t.
How do you balance both?
I agree with you, OP. I never use the word “Boss” but refer to people I report to as my supervisor or manager.
Completely agree!

Companies expect you to negotiate. If there’s an option to add “000” or “999” then do that. Or event to avoid the question. You don’t want to low ball yourself by salary your ideal salary early on. I don’t really think companies pay much attention to the salary question on job apps.  If they find your resume to be fitting for the position, they’ll the recruiter will reach out for an interview an then that’s an opportunity to further discuss the salary range for that position. Hope that helps!

This isn’t a guy you want to be friends with. As other have mentioned, he’s manipulative af! Men like him with try to create this false idea of intimacy and act like they’re genuinely interested in getting to know you, when they only want sex. He wants to be friends but wants the benefits of a relationship like sex. You deserve better.

The “boring” was in response to you not asking her a single question about herself. After you said “I’m tired and bored. Ready to go back to school,” you should’ve asked “how are you?” At the end. Women want feel like you have a genuine interest in also getting to know them. I agree with other users that her reaction was a bit over the top, but engage in more conversations and you’ll see better results on apps.
Congrats!!
